title: Unshifted coefficient-factor square
statement: Specialize the source-factor square to the identity coefficient map, invert the source factors, and cancel the derived scalar comparison.

proof.text: Apply plus_single_source_square_core to the four inverse-image and scalar-forgetting functors, the canonical pullbackIso, and the hom components of the module and abelian upperStarComp. Supply rawModuleScalar_sheaf_composition as its sheaf-level equation. This is the identity coefficient-map specialization of the source square, without importing its duplicate derivedPullbackIso declaration.

All four source factors are isomorphisms. Apply IsIso.inv_eq_inv to invert the source equation, rewrite inverse composites and functor images of inverses, precompose with the inverse derived scalar comparison, and cancel its inverse-hom pair. The single-comparison inverse formulas and upperStarComp inverse formulas give precisely the claimed coefficient square.

proof_origin.document: Stacks Project; WeilConjectures derived exact-functor comparison API
proof_origin.place: Tags 03D7 and 03Q8; Shift.ExactFunctor; generic source-square specialization and inversion

lean.statement:
theorem rawModuleScalar_coefficient_unshifted
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {W : Scheme.{u}}
    (G : Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (A B : Over W) (f : A ⟶ B) :
    (RawModuleScalarComparison.derivedPullbackIso Λ f.left).inv.app
        ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
          ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) B.hom).obj G)) ≫
      (RawModuleScalarComparison.forget Λ A.left).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
        (((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f.left).mapDerivedCategoryPlusSingleFunctor
          0).hom.app _ ≫ (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).map
          ((upperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f.left B.hom A.hom
            (Over.w f).symm).inv.app G)) ≫
      ((RawModuleScalarComparison.forget Λ A.left).mapDerivedCategoryPlusSingleFunctor
        0).hom.app _ ≫ (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).map
          (inv (RawModuleScalarComparison.pullback Λ A.hom G)) =
    (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f.left).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
      (((RawModuleScalarComparison.forget Λ B.left).mapDerivedCategoryPlusSingleFunctor
        0).hom.app _ ≫ (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).map
          (inv (RawModuleScalarComparison.pullback Λ B.hom G))) ≫
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f.left).mapDerivedCategoryPlusSingleFunctor
        0).hom.app _ ≫ (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).map
          ((upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f.left B.hom A.hom
            (Over.w f).symm).inv.app _)
